action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4 to identify best candidate in this balanced position after bxa4.
action.rationale: Position is materially balanced: White lost the c3 pawn but Black's a-file pawn advanced. Black queen on d6, knight c6 are active; White bishop h4 is developed, f1 bishop still home. No castling available immediately. Need full depth-4 coverage to compare candidates: recapture c3d4, develop f1, or attack the d6 queen with f3d4 or f3e5.
